title: Amanour workers’ strikes and sit-ins in Rabat, Tangier and Tetouan
organizer: Amanour workers; organizer not specified in opened excerpt
demands: Return dismissed workers to work and require company management to address workers’ demands; AMDH also calls on the state to intervene.
owner_note: AMDH says the strike had reached day 360 on 2021-01-14, but the exact start date and counting convention are not provided; do not assign a confirmed owner month.
notes: This is an ongoing strike/sit-in reported in January, not a new January event. Preserve it as a continuation pending the true onset and public-gathering/threshold evidence.
